title: Hear the lean
prompt: Frankie and Johnny — the left hand rocks in long-short pairs. Just listen for the skip in its step.

generatorParams.promptText: This is a shuffle — the eighths aren't even. Say "doo-dah, doo-dah" along with the bass and you've found the lean.

title: Long-short, on paper
prompt: What the shuffle actually is: written straight, played leaning.
successRule: Answer all 5 correctly — a slip means a replay.

title: Straight or shuffled?
prompt: The same riff, twice — one walks even, one skips. Catch the one that swings.
successRule: Get all 6 right — a slip means a replay.

title: The swing dial
prompt: Both cells swing — but not equally. Hear HOW lopsided each lean is.
successRule: Get all 6 right — a slip means a replay.

title: Echo the shuffle
prompt: Tap the long-short pairs with the click — LONG on the beat, short on the drawled 'and'. Say "doo-dah" while you tap.
successRule: Most taps in time AND genuinely leaning — straight taps don't count as swing.

title: The left-hand rock
prompt: Pinky on C, rock 5-to-6 in long-short pairs. The 6th is the blues sound — keep the wrist loose.
successRule: Every note right — a slip means a replay.

title: Rock through the changes
prompt: Same rock, new homes: C to F to G7 and back. The motion never stops at a barline.
successRule: Every note right — a slip means a replay.

title: Melody over the shuffle
prompt: Frankie's first phrase rides on top of your rock — hands together, lean intact.
successRule: Every note right — a slip means a replay.

title: Eyes on the symbols
prompt: No falling notes — the simplified Frankie straight off the chord symbols, counting the form.
successRule: Earn at least one star from the symbols alone — every note right; a slip means a replay.

title: The whole shuffle
prompt: The full Frankie and Johnny — melody over the rocking bass, leaning all twelve bars.
successRule: Every note right AND the take actually swings — flat eighths mean a replay.

title: Checkpoint: the shuffle
prompt: The Tier 8 cross-strand check — lean, notation, the rock, and the form.
successRule: Answer all 6 correctly — a slip means a replay.

title: Performance: Frankie and Johnny
prompt: The Tier 8 boss: the full shuffle at 84 BPM, unassisted — and it has to swing.
successRule: Earn the mastery star with a real lean: three stars at tempo, no assists, most pairs in the pocket — every note right; a slip means a replay.

title: Boss Challenge: Pinetop's groove
prompt: Your shuffle, sixteen tiers up — Pinetop's boogie groove cell. Just explore the deep end.
successRule: No stars, no failure — feel how far the lean can go.
